description: This file contains C source code implementing parsing utilities for Git configurations, including functions to parse signed, unsigned, integer, and double values, as well as boolean environment variables with unit suffix support.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)
methods.description: Determines the multiplier factor based on the suffix 'k', 'm', or 'g' in the input string.

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a signed integer value with optional unit suffix, ensuring it does not exceed specified maximum.

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned integer value with optional unit suffix, ensuring it does not exceed specified maximum.

methods.name: int git_parse_int(const char * value,int * ret)
methods.description: Parses an integer value and assigns it to the provided output variable.

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned long integer value.

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a ssize_t value with sign.

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)
methods.description: Parses a double value, supporting unit suffixes.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts text string to boolean-like indicator with 'true', 'yes', 'on', etc.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts text or numeric string to a boolean indicator, returning -1 if indeterminate.

methods.name: int git_env_bool(const char * k,int def)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as a boolean, with a default fallback.

methods.name: unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char * k,unsigned long val)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as an unsigned long with optional unit suffix, with a default fallback.

search-terms: string to number conversions in C

ctags.name: git_env_ulong
ctags.pattern: /^unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char *k, unsigned long val)$/
